tonight.headline: No claim tonight — and Tuten has missed two practices
body: Bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten, in the FLEX, did not appear to practise again on Tuesday (Heavy 3 Nov) and locks at Thursday's 19:15 CDMX kickoff. Jonathan Taylor is still the top name on the trade market (Heavy 3 Nov) and the league's review of Josh Jacobs has no ruling (PFR 2 Nov). None of the three cost Week 9 yet.

As set Bloodsports project 130.5 to Jackrabbits' 123.5. Claims close overnight at 02:00 Wednesday CDMX, and the answer is no claim: nothing on the wire is a starter here and IPADE priority never resets. The moves are the three coin-flip swaps, Gordon for Tuten first.

case.label: Their lineup
case.body: Jackrabbits carry DK Metcalf's Steelers bye and Jeanty lost his carries to Mike Washington Jr. last week by Kubiak's call (ESPN 1 Nov).

case.body: Bloodsports set the projection lineup and still lose by more than 10 — then it was the roster, not the lineup.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Before Thu 5 Nov 19:15 CDMX (Tuten locks at kickoff)
doFirst.title: Start Gordon in the FLEX, bench Tuten
doFirst.subtitle: 16.5 to 15.4 — a coin flip the projection takes, and a second missed practice points the same way.

case.label: The flip
case.body: Gordon 16.5, Tuten 15.4: inside two points. Take the projection; no thesis.

case.label: Since this morning
case.body: Tuten did not appear to practise Tuesday either (Heavy 3 Nov); Wednesday's report gives him a designation. Gordon played 82% of Miami's snaps in Week 8 (SI 2 Nov).

case.label: Why before Thursday
case.body: Once Jacksonville kick off at Baltimore, Tuten is locked into the FLEX whatever his status.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tuten outscores Gordon in Week 9 (archive).

doFirst.title: Start Rice, bench Garrett Wilson
doFirst.subtitle: 13.9 to 12.8 — a coin flip; take the projection.

case.label: The flip
case.body: Rice 13.9, Wilson 12.8: inside two points.

case.label: The facts
case.body: Rice came back in Week 8 with 7 of 8 for 53 and a TD (DK 3 Nov; archive). Wilson drew 12 targets but goes to Kansas City, 2nd-toughest on WRs. Neither is a reason; the number is.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Wilson outscores Rice in Week 9 (archive).

doFirst.title: Start Likely at TE, bench Loveland
doFirst.subtitle: 12.8 to 12.1 — a coin flip; take the projection.

case.label: The flip
case.body: Likely 12.8, Loveland 12.1: inside one point.

case.label: Against it
case.body: Loveland drew 9 targets Monday night and Kmet is out for the season (NBC 3 Nov; DK 3 Nov); Likely goes to Philadelphia, 2nd-toughest on TEs. Matchups are not overrides.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Loveland outscores Likely in Week 9 (archive).

roster.footnote: No Week 9 game has started. Rows show the lineup as set at 22:05Z; verdicts show the projection lineup. Grades are rank in fantasy points allowed to the position, StatChasers weeks 1-8 updated 3 Nov (1 = toughest).

lineupCheck.verdict: The lineup as set is 2.9 below the projection lineup across three coin flips — Gordon over Tuten, Rice over Wilson, Likely over Loveland; take the projection on all three.

worthALook.name: Mike Washington Jr.
worthALook.lead: Kubiak's call, not an injury — a free-agent look only if it repeats.

case.label: The player
case.body: 25 carries for 83 in his first start; Jeanty 2 carries and 64 receiving. Kubiak would not commit to the split (CBS 3 Nov; ESPN 1 Nov).

case.label: Why not
case.body: IPADE priority never resets and Bloodsports carry four startable backs.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A second week as the lead at San Francisco and still unrostered after claims clear — a free agent then, no priority spent.

worthALook.name: Tyler Allgeier
worthALook.lead: Love to IR — Allgeier has the job at Seattle for at least four games.

case.label: The vacancy
case.body: Jeremiyah Love headed to IR with a high ankle sprain (NBC/Rotoworld 3 Nov); Bam Knight concussed.

case.label: Why not
case.body: A claim costs IPADE priority for the season; he would be a fifth back. 36.1 came on 16 touches.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Taylor traded into a committee or Jacobs suspended — then a starter-level need, and only if he clears to free agency.

doNotChase.name: Patrick Mahomes
doNotChase.lead: Healthy and on waivers — and not better than Daniels this week.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 17.4 against Daniels 18.7; a claim drops Bloodsports to last for the season. Mahomes played Week 8 with no designation (DK 3 Nov).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A Daniels injury, or Mahomes clearing to free agency for nothing.

doNotChase.name: T.J. Hockenson
doNotChase.lead: Three tight ends already, and Murray's hamstring behind him.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 10.8 behind Likely 12.8 and Loveland 12.1; Murray's Monday availability is open, Wentz the backup (Yardbarker 2 Nov).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Likely or Loveland hurt for weeks.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 3.5 a carry on 77 carries (FootballNationUSA 3 Nov); Montgomery has missed two games and is evaluated through the week (DK 3 Nov). A fifth back here.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Montgomery ruled out and Jacobs suspended.

doNotChase.name: Kenny Gainwell
doNotChase.lead: Rushing volume, one target, and a healthy Irving.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 39 carries and 1 target over two games (CBS 3 Nov); Irving is not injured (DK 3 Nov).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: An Irving injury.
